title: Come And Go With Me
lyrics_plain:
The Dell-vikings
Miscellaneous
Come Go With Me
COME GO WITH ME
THE DEL VIKINGS

Love, love me darlin'
Come and go with me,
Please don't send me
'Way beyond the sea;
I need you, darlin',
So come go with me.

Come, come, come, come,
Come into my heart,
Tell me, darlin',
We will never part;
I need you, darlin',
So come go with me.

Yes, I need you,
Yes, I really need you,
Please say you'll never leave me.
Well, say, you never,
Yes, you really never,
You never give me a chance.

Repeat all
